rawThesis: TLKM dividennya tinggi dan growth kuat, valuasinya juga murah dibanding emiten telco lain.

context.text: Latest dividend versus prior payments (one-off check): latest dividend vs prior median 133.0% (as of 2026-06-18).

supports.text: Trailing dividend yield: trailing dividend yield 9.7% (TTM).
Yield versus own historical average yield: trailing dividend yield 9.7% (TTM); historical average yield 6.1% (FY2022-FY2026).
Time since the latest dividend payment (recency check): days since last dividend 105 (as of 2026-06-18).

statement.text: Change in annual yield versus change in dividend per share, latest completed fiscal year: yield change 30.5% (FY2025 vs FY2024); dividend per share change 19.0% (FY2025 vs FY2024).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Did the yield rise mostly because the share price fell, not because the dividend grew?
Is the company paying out almost all of its earnings, leaving little room to keep the dividend up?

openQuestions: Will the payout policy continue? Future dividends are not knowable from reported data.

context.text: Latest-quarter revenue growth, same quarter year-on-year: revenue growth YoY 6.4% (2026Q2 vs 2025Q2).
Revenue growth trend versus the prior quarter (deceleration check): revenue growth YoY 6.4% (2026Q2 vs 2025Q2); prior-quarter revenue growth YoY 1.5% (2026Q1 vs 2025Q1).
Earnings growth versus revenue growth (divergence check): revenue growth YoY 6.4% (2026Q2 vs 2025Q2); net income growth YoY 21.6% (2026Q2 vs 2025Q2).

weakens.text: Last full fiscal year net income growth: annual net income growth -24.7% (FY2025 vs FY2024).

supports.text: Latest-quarter net income growth, same quarter year-on-year: net income growth YoY 21.6% (2026Q2 vs 2025Q2).

statement.text: Prior fiscal year net income growth (base effect): prior-year net income growth -3.7% (FY2024 vs FY2023); net income growth YoY 21.6% (2026Q2 vs 2025Q2).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Is this growth a rebound from a weak prior year rather than new strength?

statement.text: Net income growth minus revenue growth, latest quarter: net income growth minus revenue growth 15.2 pp (2026Q2 vs 2025Q2).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Is profit growing much faster than revenue, so the business itself is not growing as fast as earnings suggest?

statement.text: Latest fiscal year ROE versus its average over the prior three years: ROE change -2.9 pp (FY2025 vs FY2022-FY2024).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Is return on equity falling even while profit grows?

openQuestions: Is growth concentrated in one business segment? Sectors does not expose segment data.
Did one-off items (asset sales, provisions released) lift net income? Not identifiable from summary financials.

interpretation.text: TLKM's latest quarter shows a net income growth of 21.6% year-on-year with revenue growth at 6.4%, reflecting a 15.2 percentage point difference. However, the last full fiscal year saw a net income decline of 24.7%, and the latest fiscal year ROE decreased by 2.9 percentage points compared to the prior three-year average, indicating mixed fundamental growth signals.
